class.name: VehicleConfig
class.brief_description: One-shot aggregate of Vehicle setup resources.
class.description: VehicleConfig supplies the resources consumed during one-shot Vehicle initialization. Engine, gearbox, and suspension data are required. Aerodynamics and turbo data are optional. Direct drivetrain setup copies each driven axle's two wheel bodies, positive [member Axle.drive_share], and [member Axle.differential_data] into [code]DrivenAxle[/code] and [code]DifferentialSettings[/code] values. One through eight driven axles are supported; positive shares are normalized as flat weights with no inter-axle differential. The network receives direct solve arguments for timestep, signed ratio, engagement, and clutch capacity, and retains [code]ClutchTelemetry[/code] after successful atomic commit. VehicleSetupValidation reports missing major resources and invalid composition before runtime state is configured; changing this resource after initialization does not reconfigure the Vehicle.
